We now have 2 of these, and love them except putting them together was not easy as instructions were unclear.

Frustrating to assemble and the instructions could have been clearer. Extra holes in the bread box parts made us confused as to the correct place to put screws. Also part of the Alan key felt sharp in the hand. Once we figured it out, it was a relief. Overall the bread box/ bin is good value for money. The bamboo feels solid and robust. The shelf on top is also a reason for getting it. I would recommend it for someone with lots of patience. I would suggest that if possible the instructions are changed to make them clearer.
